title: Request parameter is interpolated into SQL
problem: the changed query interpolates attacker-controlled input directly into SQL
trigger: a caller supplies SQL syntax in the id query parameter
consequence: the caller can alter the database query and access or modify unintended data
evidence: the new line inserts req.query.id into a template literal passed directly to db.query
recommendation: keep the parameterized query and validate that the identifier is numeric

verification.reason: The supplied value reaches the SQL parser without parameter binding.

title: Lookup accepts non-numeric identifiers
problem: the changed path no longer enforces the numeric identifier contract
trigger: the request contains a non-numeric id
consequence: the endpoint sends an invalid lookup to the database
evidence: the PR requirement says numeric ID while the changed line passes the raw query value
recommendation: validate and reject non-numeric identifiers before constructing the query

verification.reason: The explicit numeric-ID requirement is not enforced by the changed path.
